answer: Every identity pays in thought each round. Because the reef is unpredictable in advance, answers cannot be bought wholesale and replayed. Every checkpoint root is anchored to a public chain and the full history replays for anyone. That makes each attestation permanently attributable: a nectar that vouched for junk is a timestamped record the audit lanes can act on later. What cannot be bought is a jury that already trusts you. Each harbor has to be earned inside a panel system that prices collusion at the loss of every seat granted. Seal 1iunc.
